title: Ubulungisa Phakathi Kwabarhwebi
intro: Umntu othile wema phambi kwabantu abatyekelwe kukutsalwa yinzuzo, ebabizela ekunyanisekeni nasekulungelweni kwezenzo zabo. Lo mkhonzi ka-Allah walumkisa ngokunika imilinganiselo emifutshane nokuphambanisa izikali. Abantu bala ukumamela, besongela ngokumgxotha lo mntu emhlabeni wabo. Umhlaba ngokwawo wawuya kuphakama ukuze ubagwebe. Ngubani lo mntu owayemele ubulungisa phakathi kwabarhwebi?
clues: Ndathunywa njengomthunywa kubantu ababengene nzulu kurhwebo norhwebo.
Abantu bam babenika isilinganiselo esifutshane xa belinganisa iimpahla zabanye.
Bandisongela ngokundigxotha kweli lizwe ukuba ndiqhubeka nokubabiza ukuba bakhonze uThixo.
Abantu bam babanjwe yinyikima enamandla eyabashiya bengenabomi emakhayeni abo.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
